scope: One full-main L-citrulline human crossover qualification and one partial-main chronic oral L-arginine PAD qualification; four targeted discovery queries; no global evidence census.

citrulline.title: Citrulline Supplementation Improves Microvascular Function and Muscle Strength in Middle-Aged and Older Adults with Type 2 Diabetes
citrulline.reading: Complete scientific main, all three tables/five captions and all five native main figures; full current registry. No registry history or separate protocol.

intervention.identity: Citrulline in article; L-citrulline explicitly in current own registry
intervention.form: NOW Foods capsules, 750 mg each; no malate/AKG or other active ingredient described
intervention.comparator: Matching microcrystalline-cellulose capsules; registry describes 6 g/day
intervention.usual_care: Usual medications/diet/activity maintained; 13/16 analyzed participants on metformin. This was a single randomized supplement difference on usual care, not medication-free monotherapy or the assigned DMD combination.
intervention.received_exposure_limit: Dose assigned by capsule content; adherence by returned capsules; no independent batch chemistry.

design.withdrawal_reasons: Not specified by cause; mild discomfort not linked to assignment or withdrawal.
design.analysis: Complete-both-period sample; no ITT or imputation reported

population.baseline_function_limit: No participant met the stated sarcopenic low-grip or low-appendicular-mass criteria.

statistics.primaryness: Current registry lists strength as secondary; main sample-size calculation is based on RHI. Prospective original registry version not read.
statistics.test: Two-way repeated-measures time×condition ANOVA; Bonferroni-adjusted post-hoc tests when interaction significant.
limits: No described family-wide adjustment across all outcomes.
No strength treatment-contrast CI or meaningful-change threshold.
Complete-case selection, small sample, no durability or daily-function assessment.

calf_10RM_load.limit: Highest load through ten plantarflexion repetitions, not maximal isometric or isolated specific force. No rounding-derived treatment estimate.

plasma_arginine.source: Table 2; printed unit preserved, no silent dimensional correction

vascular_strength_correlation.limits: Plot contains placebo and citrulline change markers from the crossover; no repeated-person correlation model described. No mediation or causal vascular mechanism inferred.

outcomes.muscle_mass_change: Not measured: DXA at baseline only
outcomes.bub1b_bubr1: No expression, protein, stability, checkpoint or chromosome-fidelity assay in the complete scientific main.

safety.reported: One mild stomach discomfort, no other adverse effects reported. Assignment/withdrawal relation unstated.
safety.limits: No detailed AE table; selected short study does not establish safety equivalence.

registry_current_limits.enrollment_discrepancy: Unresolved; no additional analyzed participants inferred.
registry_current_limits.other_discrepancies: Structured inclusion age40–75 versus exclusion line>65; current secondary strength includes leg extension not presented in this article. No selective-reporting cause inferred.

funding_and_notice.funding: Authors state no external funding; NOW Foods donated both products.
funding_and_notice.notice_check: No commentCorrectionList in retrieved EPMC core record; not a comprehensive notice audit.

citrulline.judgment: Preliminary controlled human functional comparator; retain real calf-load benefit and grip null, without generalized strength restoration or automatic nominee replacement.

arginine.title: L-arginine supplementation in peripheral arterial disease: no benefit and possible harm
arginine.reading: Complete official abstract; selected indexed publisher Methods/opening Results; complete current registry. Full scientific main/native figures/tables/supplements not accessible and not claimed.

intervention.schedule_excerpt: 1 g three times daily with meals
intervention.chemical_limit: Counterion and full excipient composition not verified; no HCl/AKG/malate/mixture equivalence.

design.population: Adults with stable intermittent claudication due to PAD; accessible Methods age≥45 and ABI<.9
design.final_primary_analysis_denominator: Not independently verified from inaccessible remainder
design.excerpt_analysis: Modified ITT: ≥1 dose and ≥1 valid post-randomization treadmill; LOCF for missing six-month value; baseline-adjusted analysis
design.primary: Six-month change in absolute claudication distance, Skinner–Gardner treadmill

primary_walking.source: Complete abstract direction plus indexed main Results ordering
primary_walking.ordering_limit: Abstract prints28.3% versus11.5% after saying arginine improved less; group labels retained from explicit direction/indexed Results.
primary_walking.interpretation: Both groups improved; active improvement was smaller. Not universal deterioration or a mortality result.

outcomes.biomarkers: Plasma arginine increased; abstract reports NO-availability measures reduced or not improved against placebo.
outcomes.bubr1: No assay reported in the portions read; no absence claim for inaccessible remainder.
outcomes.harms: Complete AE/withdrawal tables not read. Do not infer safety equivalence or specific mortality effect.

registry_current_limits.description: Earlier80-person six-week dose-ranging and planned12-month prolonged study; must not pool with133-person six-month publication.
registry_current_limits.exclusions: Active/prior malignancy among registry exclusions; transfer limit, not blanket contraindication.

funding_and_notice.sponsor: Stanford; NHLBI collaborator/funding in current registry/indexed Methods
funding_and_notice.comment: PMID18268155 is a comment/author reply; text not read, not classified as erratum.

positive_context_pointer.title: Restoring vascular nitric oxide formation by l-arginine improves the symptoms of intermittent claudication in patients with peripheral arterial occlusive disease
positive_context_pointer.reading: Primary abstract returned during bounded discovery only; full article not qualified
positive_context_pointer.context: Short intravenous L-arginine, different comparator/route/duration; cannot offset or inherit the chronic oral result. Exact denominator/allocation and within-versus-between interpretation remain unqualified.

arginine.judgment: Discriminating adverse-direction functional comparator for this chronic oral PAD regimen; no positive lead or global all-route harm claim.

competition.decision: Keep provisional nominations unresolved by these two sources; retain citrulline functional reserve and oral-arginine counterevidence explicitly.
competition.fairness: No selective demand for MVA proof. Controlled citrulline load evidence is real, but small selected secondary endpoint with grip null and no walking/durability; niacin bridge and apitegromab SMA motor-function context are distinct, not demonstrated superior across trials.
competition.existing_combo: new-citrulline-metformin-dmd and prior metformin unchanged; no component efficacy inheritance.
